tools.name: cua_list_windows
tools.label: Lista las ventanas de nivel superior con window_id, pid, app_name, título, bounds y si están en pantalla. Una app suele tener ventanas auxiliares pequeñas y vacías: elige la ventana por título y tamaño, nunca la primera

pid.description: Optional pid filter. When set, only this pid's windows are returned.

on_screen_only.description: When true, drop windows that aren't currently on-screen. Default false.

tools.name: cua_list_apps
tools.label: Lista las aplicaciones en ejecución e instaladas con su pid y estado

tools.name: cua_screen_size
tools.label: Devuelve el tamaño de la pantalla principal y su escala

tools.name: cua_window_state
tools.label: Lee una ventana: elementos de accesibilidad con element_token, rol, etiqueta, valor y acciones, más una captura. Hazlo una vez antes de actuar sobre esa ventana: la lectura siguiente invalida los tokens anteriores. Si solo buscas un elemento usa query e include_screenshot=false para no llenar el contexto

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Must belong to `pid`. Enumerate via `list_windows` or read from `launch_app`'s `windows` array.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring. Projects both tree_markdown and structured elements to matches plus ancestors while preserving original indices. Compare total_element_count with returned_element_count.

include_screenshot.description: Default true — returns a grounding screenshot alongside the tree. Set false to skip the grab and return tree only (the cheap path for re-indexing before an element ax action).

max_elements.description: Cap on the total number of UIA nodes walked. Truncates depth-first; markdown and structured elements truncate together. Omit for the default (5 000). Lower for Electron / large web apps that produce 10k+ element trees.

max_depth.description: Cap on the UIA-tree walk depth. Nodes whose rendered indent would exceed this are omitted. Omit for the default (25). Lower for deep menu / Electron trees.

tools.name: cua_zoom
tools.label: Amplía una zona de la captura de una ventana a resolución nativa; para hacer clic en ella usa from_zoom=true

pid.description: Optional target process ID. When omitted, the unique current snapshot for this session and HWND is used.

x1.description: Left edge of the region (resized-image pixels).

y1.description: Top edge of the region (resized-image pixels).

x2.description: Right edge of the region (resized-image pixels).

y2.description: Bottom edge of the region (resized-image pixels).

tools.name: cua_click
tools.label: Hace clic en un elemento (element_token, preferido: no mueve el cursor ni roba el foco) o en coordenadas x,y de la captura de la ventana. delivery_mode=foreground solo si el modo en segundo plano no surte efecto

pid.description: Target process ID for window scope. Omit with scope=desktop for screen-absolute coordinates from get_desktop_state.

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

x.description: X in window-local screenshot pixels — same space as the PNG get_window_state returns. Must be provided together with y.

y.description: Y in window-local screenshot pixels. Must be provided together with x.

action.description: Accessibility action for an element_token target. "expand" opens the element through UIA ExpandCollapsePattern, or clicks the dropdown half of an MSAA split button. Omit for the default invoke.

modifier.description: Modifier keys held during the action: cmd, shift, option/alt, ctrl.

from_zoom.description: When true, x and y are pixel coordinates in the last `zoom` image for this pid. The driver maps them back to window coords.

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_drag
tools.label: Arrastra desde from_x,from_y hasta to_x,to_y en píxeles de la captura de la ventana

from_x.description: Drag-start X in window-local screenshot pixels.

from_y.description: Drag-start Y in window-local screenshot pixels.

to_x.description: Drag-end X in window-local screenshot pixels.

to_y.description: Drag-end Y in window-local screenshot pixels.

modifier.description: Modifier keys held during the action: cmd, shift, option/alt, ctrl.

from_zoom.description: When true, coordinates are in the last zoom image for this pid.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of drag path. Default: 500.

steps.description: Number of intermediate WM_MOUSEMOVE events. Default: 20.

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_scroll
tools.label: Desplaza el contenido de una ventana o de un elemento

pid.description: Target process ID for window scope. Omit with scope=desktop for screen-absolute coordinates from get_desktop_state.

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Omit when element_token is supplied; otherwise auto-resolves the pid's first visible window.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

x.description: With pid/window_id: window-local screenshot X used to target a nested scroll surface in foreground mode. Without pid/window_id: screen-absolute X for desktop scope. Must be paired with y.

y.description: With pid/window_id: window-local screenshot Y used to target a nested scroll surface in foreground mode. Without pid/window_id: screen-absolute Y for desktop scope. Must be paired with x.

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_type_text
tools.label: Escribe texto en un campo. Con element_token escribe por accesibilidad y, en apps modernas (Bloc de notas, Calculadora, Configuración), reemplaza el valor completo del campo. Enter, Tab o flechas van con cua_press_key

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

element_token.description: Opaque element handle from get_window_state. When supplied, type_text writes through UIA ValuePattern and reads that exact element back by handle. The shared ActionResult is confirmed only when the complete expected…

text.description: Text to insert at the focused element's cursor.

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_press_key
tools.label: Pulsa una tecla (Enter, Escape, Tab, flechas…) con modificadores opcionales

window_id.description: HWND for the target window. Omit when element_token is supplied; otherwise auto-resolves the pid's first visible window.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

key.description: Key name (return, tab, escape, up, down, left, right, space, delete, home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12, letter, digit).

modifiers.description: Optional modifier names held while the key is pressed (ctrl/shift/alt/win).

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_hotkey
tools.label: Pulsa una combinación de teclas a la vez, por ejemplo ["ctrl","s"]

window_id.description: Explicit HWND when the pid owns multiple windows.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

keys.description: Modifier(s) and one non-modifier key, e.g. ["ctrl", "c"].

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_set_value
tools.label: Establece de golpe el valor de un campo con el patrón Value de accesibilidad

window_id.description: HWND of the window. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

value.description: New value. UIA will coerce to the element's native type.

delivery_mode.description: Input delivery mode. 'background' (default) never swaps foreground: it routes through UIA Invoke / PostMessage and the window is never raised. For targets whose input stack silently drops posted events…

tools.name: cua_invoke_menu
tools.label: Abre una ruta exacta del menú de la aplicación nivel a nivel y ejecuta su último elemento

pid.description: Process ID of the application that owns the menu.

window_id.description: Window ID from list_windows whose menu is invoked.

path.description:
Menu labels from the top-level menu to the item, e.g. `["File", "Save As..."]`
(1 to 16 labels).

tools.name: cua_launch_app
tools.label: Abre una aplicación por nombre o ruta sin robar el foco; luego localiza su ventana con cua_list_windows

name.description: App display name. Tried against the `shell:AppsFolder` index first for packaged-app lookup; on a miss, passed to ShellExecuteEx's PATH search.

path.description: Full path to executable. Windows-only; takes precedence over name/bundle_id/aumid (but not over `launch_path`).

additional_arguments.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to the launched process (or activation arguments for packaged apps).

creates_new_application_instance.description: Accepted for parity; no-op on Windows (ShellExecuteEx always creates a new process).

tools.name: cua_bring_to_front
tools.label: Trae una ventana al primer plano; quita el foco al usuario, úsalo solo si una acción lo necesita

window_id.description: Optional HWND. Defaults to pid's first visible top-level window.
